properties.name: Noah's Altar
properties.description: Noah built an altar and offered burnt offerings. God made a covenant never to destroy the earth by flood again.
properties.debate: The altar would have been built shortly after leaving the ark, somewhere in the Ararat region.

properties.name: Rainbow Covenant Location
properties.popup: God's promise to all creation - Genesis 9:12-17
properties.description: God set His bow in the clouds as a sign of the covenant. Never again would all flesh be cut off by flood waters.
properties.archaeology: The rainbow is a universal phenomenon, visible to all humanity as a reminder of God's promise.

properties.name: Noah's Vineyard
properties.description: Noah, a man of the soil, planted a vineyard. He drank of the wine and became drunk in his tent.
properties.debate: Armenia has ancient viticulture traditions. Some consider it the birthplace of wine, consistent with Noah's vineyard.

properties.name: Ham's Sin Location
properties.description: Ham saw his father's nakedness and told his brothers. Shem and Japheth walked backward to cover Noah.
properties.debate: Ham's sin may have involved more than merely seeing. His son Canaan was cursed, suggesting deeper transgression.

properties.name: Prophecy over the Nations
properties.description: Noah prophesied: Canaan would be a servant; God would enlarge Japheth; Shem's line would be blessed.
properties.archaeology: The descendants of Shem (Semites), Ham (Canaanites, Africans), and Japheth (Europeans, Asians) spread as prophesied.
